description:
Let CI (and later laptops) reuse buck2 action and test results through a shared REAPI cache, local execution first, remote execution only if CI stays CPU-bound. Research and gap analysis: docs/research/remote-execution-and-caching.md (commit adc3619d), §5 (gaps G0-G11) and §7 (phased plan).

Open decisions (§7 open questions): who may write (CI main only vs every PR; never laptops); hosted (BuildBuddy/BuildFetch) vs self-hosted bazel-remote + bucket; macOS CI writer in scope?; ship as turnkey module options for consumers or turnkey-CI only; coarseness of the env salt (whole shell vs per-toolchain); should tk own the buck2 daemon environment.
title: Share buck2 build and test results across machines via a remote cache
